record.question: Which cricket player wins the Polly Umrigar Award 2017?
record.explanation: BCCI's dated 1 March 2017 announcement names Virat Kohli for the award presented on 8 March 2017. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed.
